$comment: One NeoRadar package for all of France, built from the French vACC military GNG sector file (LFFM), which covers every French FIR. 'sectorFile' is the basename under LFXX/Sectors/ in the source tree; 'firs' are the source folders whose ASRs, login profiles and CoFrance maps the package carries (the first FIR wins a duplicated callsign); 'excludeAsrs' are globs, relative to a FIR's ASR folder, of the displays left out (the centre ones: NeoRadar serves approach and below for now; and the Legacy APP displays, superseded by the CoFrance approach ones); 'excludeLoginFacilities' are the EuroScope facility numbers whose login profiles are left out (6: centre); 'dataFolder' is the folder whose ICAO and NavData are used (default: the first FIR).

publish.$comment: neoradar-cli distribute's publish settings. Each package goes to <s3PathPrefix><namespace> in the R2 bucket and is served at <baseUrlPrefix><namespace>. The R2 keys come from the two environment variables named here (GitHub secrets in the Publish Release workflow).

packages.name: LFXX France
packages.description: French vACC package for approach, tower and ground in every French FIR (Paris, Reims, Brest, Bordeaux, Marseille), with the military airfields
